title: Read: which classic-control task?
summary: v1 (all nets padded to 8 inputs/4 actions, LunarLander's native shape): Claude Opus 5.5 named the right environment from the raw weights in 7/20 main and 2/8 permuted attempts, answering LunarLander in 26/28. v2 (padded to 10 inputs/5 actions, chosen to avoid any classic-control shape, but it turned out to match PettingZoo MPE simple_adversary's good agent): 6/20 main and 1/8 permuted correct, most common answer MPE simple_adversary (21/28) at low confidence (mean 0.35 on wrong answers vs 0.67 on right ones). Every response that inferred padding was right (7/7) and every one that did not was wrong (0/21). The pre-registered bar for reading the weights beyond the shape (>= 10/20 and >= 3/5 on two non-LunarLander nets) was not met. Random-init controls were called untrained in 3/3 (v1) and 3/3 (v2). Total API cost $4.79.
